labels.fr: Atteinte de la cible de produit

formula: sum(F07.outputs linked to F03.id with identical output_unit) / F03.target * 100
interpretation: Measures output achievement, not outcome or impact. Never sum heterogeneous output units.

formula: sum(F19.spent linked to F03.id) / sum(F07.outputs linked to F03.id with identical output_unit)
interpretation: Cash costs only; compare the same indicator, unit, scope and quality standard. Lower cost alone does not establish better quality.

labels.fr: Coût prévu par unité de produit

interpretation: Benchmark, not a universal performance threshold.
Spending rate is not effectiveness or impact.
